statement: Does not beat the closing line on every scored market. football result trails the closing line. Brier 0.5951 versus 0.5778. Log loss 0.9965 versus 0.9709. The 5% rule returned -7.3% on 56859 bets across 62,819 games.
notes: Walk-forward 1X2 against the closing price in matches.json (Pinnacle close when it exists, else Pinnacle, else Bet365).
The first 30 matches of each league are used to start the averages and are not scored.
The file has no closing totals or handicaps, so over/under and the goal line are model outputs without a closing-line score.
A lower Brier score and a lower log loss are better. The model beats the close only when both are better.
